about: Every member of the team that runs this site, human and agent: who they are, what they own, what they cannot do, and when they run. The shape follows web-summit.sgit.ai's roster, with two fields added: cannot and schedule. Kept by conductor@the-ultimate-insider. Members marked proposed are proposals until the operator agrees them; no scheduled task exists yet.

members.name: Dinis Cruz
members.summary: Gives the talk, writes the brief, and operates the agents: approves the schedule, hands vault keys to sessions out of band, and decides what goes to main.
owns: the talk: what it argues, which act gets more time, every line said on stage
the brief, and every editorial call on what the site claims
promotion to main
the scheduled tasks: creating, pausing and deleting them
the vault keys, handed to each session out of band
members.schedule: Reads the conductor's digest after each run; answers its asks.
rules: Agents write next to the brief, never over it.

members.name: conductor@the-ultimate-insider
members.summary: Maps the work, keeps the roster and the schedule, runs each scheduled run as one step per agent, and writes the digest at the end of every run. Until the other roles are wired it does their work by hand, under their rules.
owns: the roster (data/team.json) and the schedule (data/schedule.json)
the run: the order, the lock, and the run ledger (admin/runs/)
the digest after every run: what each step did, what is blocked and on whom
CLAUDE.md and REALITY.md
cannot: create, change or delete a scheduled task (the operator does)
hold a vault key beyond the session it was given in
members.schedule: Every run: opens it, steps through the agents in data/schedule.json, closes it with the digest.
rules: A run that dies leaves a lock; the next run notices it and says so first.
Nothing loops: one step per agent per run, twelve minutes at most.
Say what is blocked and on whom, by name.
Keys never go into a file, a page or a message.

members.name: Security
members.role: Checks first and last in every run
members.summary: Opens every run: is there a hold, did anything change that nobody committed, is there a key, token or password in any tracked file. Closes every run with the same checks over what the run changed. Reports, never fixes.
owns: the hold: one file that stops every other step while it is open
the leak check over the tree and over each run's diff
the findings ledger (admin/security/findings.jsonl)
cannot: fix what it finds (it reports to the owner and the conductor)
members.schedule: First and last step of every run.
rules: If a hold is open, every other step stops.
A finding names the file and the line, never the secret.

members.name: Researcher
members.summary: Captures and hashes every source the talk cites, starting with the article's: the five incidents, the 82-to-1 survey, the two outages, the zero-day, the 48 per cent, the Gartner and MIT numbers, ASRS and CIRCIA. Sweeps for new agent incidents once a day and files candidates for the operator, so the talk's public record is as current as the day it is given.
owns: evidence/: one folder per source, with the capture, its hash and the date
the claims register: each claim the talk makes, the source it rests on, and whether that source still says it
the incident candidates: new public agent incidents, filed for the operator to accept or drop
cannot: put a claim on a slide (it files; @Deck and the operator decide)
use a source it has not captured
rules: A claim without a captured source is a gap, and the register says so.
A measured finding, a position and a guess are labelled as three different things.

members.name: Deck
members.role: The slides and the speaker notes
members.summary: Turns the argument into the deck: three acts and a turn, forty minutes, one figure per act, evidence on screen with its source. Writes the slides and speaker notes to the decks/v2 contract in the deck vault, and keeps a time budget per act.
owns: the deck vault's decks/ folder: manifest, slide source, notes, figures
the time budget: minutes per act against the forty
the outline, kept next to the brief, never over it
cannot: cite a source the researcher has not captured
put a URL in a slide
rules: Every number on a slide points at its row in the claims register.

members.name: Dev
members.summary: Builds the site: the page that plays the deck out of the vault, the markdown twin of every page, llms.txt, the gate, the version on every push, GitHub Pages and the CNAME. Copies the estate's deck viewer rather than writing a new one.
owns: the build and the gate (admin/build/)
the release: version.txt, admin/versions.json, the deploy, the check that the live site shows the new version
the deck viewer, to the decks/v2 contract
cannot: disable a check to get green
members.schedule: Morning and evening runs, weekdays, after @Deck.
rules: A red gate is no release.
Edit the sources, never a generated page.

members.name: Reviewer
members.summary: Second wave. Reviewers from other vendors read the deck and the claims register on a schedule, the way the newsroom's reviews lane runs. Wired once there is a deck to review.
